title: ECL ACS decision extension value v1
description: The value of ecl.ext.acs-decision.v1 on a DCMP-2 decision response: the OWASP ACS Guardian decision the ECL decision depends on, the ACS request_id of the step, the session chain head the Guardian published for it, and, for a modify, the digest of the RFC 8785 form of its modifications object (AC1-005, AC1-008).

request_hash.description: The step's ContextEntry request_hash, required when the deployment claims ACS-Audit.
